{"metadata":{"description":"Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)","id":"gh:1336553039","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-search-firecrawl","slug":"elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl","topics":["cordis","dsh","dsh-plugin","firecrawl"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-firecrawl"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (`ctx.web`): it make"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s the built-in `web_search` tool run on Firecrawl's search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek route"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" the built-in `web_search` tool run on Firecrawl's search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek route."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin is a Cordis function plugin that registers a `WebSearchProvider` (`id: firecrawl`) into t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"he seam — it does not own `ctx.web` and does not register a model-facing tool (the tool schema stays"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`). It calls Firecrawl's `POST /v1/search` endpoint and maps the fla"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"t `data[]` into the seam's normalized `WebSearchResult`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The API key is configured in **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details**, not a separate Settings navigat"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ion entry. The form follows Harness semantic colors in both light and dark themes; `$FIRECRAWL_API_K"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"EY` remains available as a compatibility fallback."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness official packages on the `0.2.1-rc.5` line, Cordis `4.0.5`, Schemastery `3.18.5`,"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" and Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. The old `0.1.x` configuration API is not supported; see the upg"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rade guide. Do not mix Harness release lines in one profile; check with `npm ls @deepseek-ai/dsh-web"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"`.
- A Firecrawl API key. Get one at firecrawl.dev."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Choose **one** of the following:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Option 1 — global `dsh` CLI**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Option 2 — `deepseek-harness` source checkout** (there `dsh` is a pnpm workspace script, not a glo"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"bal binary; run it from the workspace root):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and appends the bundle to the profile's l"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ayer stack automatically. The bundle patch inserts the `web-search-firecrawl` plugin row and switche"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s the `web` seam row to `searchProvider: firecrawl` (replacing the base bundle's `deepseek-official`"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"), while preserving `fetchProvider: http` for page retrieval."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"After installing, **restart `dsh web`**, then hard-refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) so the browse"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"r half and its settings page load:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Verify: **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details** should show the configuration form, and asking the ag"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ent for a web search should route through Firecrawl. Without a key, a search fails with `WEB_PROVIDE"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"R_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"To keep DeepSeek search as the default and enable Firecrawl per instance instead, restate the `web` "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"row in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` afterwards — the last write wins per row. The base bund"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"le pins `searchProvider: deepseek-official`, so `$DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` selects the provider only"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" when the `web` row sets no `searchProvider`: restate `web` with only its fetch selection (`- id: we"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"b` + `config: { fetchProvider: http }`) for env selection, or with `searchProvider: deepseek-officia"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"chProvider: http }`) for env selection, or with `searchProvider: deepseek-official` to pin DeepSeek."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Update"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Global `dsh` CLI:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`deepseek-harness` source checkout — run from the workspace root:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`dsh plugin update` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory; `--latest` upgrades to the latest"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" published version regardless of the currently installed range. After updating, **restart `dsh web`*"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"*, then hard-refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R). If the plugin is installed in another profile, rep"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"lace `web` with that profile name."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Global `dsh` CLI:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`deepseek-harness` source checkout — run from the workspace root:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`dsh plugin remove` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and also removes the package from "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"`dsh.profile.bundles`. Once the bundle layer is gone, the `web` seam row reverts to the base bundle'"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"s `deepseek-official` provider. Restart `dsh web` for the removal to take effect in the running proc"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"eepseek-official` provider. Restart `dsh web` for the removal to take effect in the running process."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The command removes the package and its mount, but not settings-page values. If you also want to del"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ete the saved API key, clear it on the **Firecrawl** page before uninstalling. If the plugin was ins"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"talled into another profile, replace `web` with that profile name."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Switching search providers"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Installing the plugin switches the `web` seam's `searchProvider` to `firecrawl`, so Firecrawl replac"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"es the original web search by default. In **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details**, the **Use Firecraw"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"l** switch at the top selects between the two providers live:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- **On (default)**: Firecrawl `POST /v1/search` is used.
- **Off**: the registered `firecrawl` provi"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"der delegates to the original DeepSeek search implementation, so the model keeps using the shipped D"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"eepSeek search route; DeepSeek's endpoint/model still resolve from the original `web-search-deepseek"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"e; DeepSeek's endpoint/model still resolve from the original `web-search-deepseek` settings section."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The fallback retains the official implementation's account authentication, credential resolution, an"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"d `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` Session logging. The switch applies immediately without a restar"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"t. Firecrawl credentials and request settings are preserved while off."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Configuring the API key"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Open **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details**:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"1. Paste `fc-...` into the **API Key** field and save. The eye button beside the field toggles plain"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"-text visibility for the current draft.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- **A snippet is Firecrawl's `description` excerpt, not a search-engine summary** — it can be long p"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"age markdown, so the provider bounds it to `maxSnippetChars`; entries without a description carry no"},{"id":"p41s3","text":" snippet at all (URL-only).
- **Only `limit`/`maxSnippetChars` are exposed** — Firecrawl's other con"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"trols (language, country, recency, location, targeting, scrape options) wait on provider-neutral Ser"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"vice Definition fields in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web`.
- **Abort classification is error-shape-based** — "},{"id":"p41s6","text":"only a `DOMException` named `AbortError` maps to `WEB_ABORTED`; an abort carrying a custom reason su"},{"id":"p41s7","text":"rfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`."}],"truncated":true}
